args.body:
Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief jobs-report update says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant presents itself as a cozy, alpine-inspired Swiss eatery with cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. The site highlights rustic wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The text is straightforward and makes your contact email easy to find. I'd suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and the purpose of the site, plus a few examples of your interests or work, to give visitors more to explore. A small wording improvement would be: “This is Dora’s personal website.”

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a clear starting point. I'd love to see more detail: favorite trails, trip stories, photos, or practical hiking tips would make it more engaging and useful. A short introduction about you and what readers can expect would also help the blog feel more welcoming.

final_text:
Completed in the requested order:

1. Summarized both websites shared in **#general** and posted the summary to **#random**.
2. Visited Dora’s and Eve’s websites, invited Dora to Slack using the email listed on her website, and sent each of them feedback via direct message.
